name: Path Feature
summary: Warlock Path Feature Seer of Battle Once per short rest, give one ally advantage on an attack, save, or check as a reaction. Warlock Path Feature Storm Warlock Your first damaging psychic power each combat deals +1d8 damage. Spirit Guardian Allies protected by your Rune Ward also gain advantage on the next fear or psychic saving throw they make before your next turn.
